design_goal.primary: Explore the declared TtgR pocket-library positions for a naltrexone-favoring structural proxy while retaining apo fold and dimer integrity.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: This smoke baseline succeeds only if the complete blind runtime executes, obeys the site-specific amino-acid contract, emits auditable Dynamic-AST/island lineage, and returns finite same-protocol apo/target/counter structural proxies. It does not establish an allosteric sensor.

dual_ast_scope.degradation_note: Current global AST v2 replaces all executable mappings and requires every executable FunctionalNode to have a dynamic edge. Therefore the six guardrails remain immutable evaluator/semantic-graph responsibilities rather than falsely appearing as LLM-rewirable executable nodes.

positive_signals: All four states use exactly the same candidate protein sequence.
Apo and ligand-state structures retain finite confidence and homodimer evidence.
Naltrexone pocket evidence exceeds or complements the relative End/Tam structural proxies.
Apo-to-holo hinge/DBD motion occurs without global fold or dimer collapse.
failure_signals: Any substitution outside the active AST selector or outside the eleven library positions.
Any residue outside the position-specific observed alphabet.
More than four substitutions from WT.
Missing state structures, severe confidence loss, or apparent selectivity caused by fold/dimer loss.

residue_level_constraints.policy: LLM preferences are soft. The controller injects the site-specific alphabet and the evaluator fails closed on violations.

information_gaps: No TtgR operator-DNA sequence or DNA-bound candidate state is included in this blind smoke.
Static structure models do not predict basal repression, derepression, dose response, or intracellular expression.
Target/counter contact margins are not binding free-energy or reporter margins.
The first protocol has no WT structure-derived calibration thresholds; absolute floors are smoke checks only.
provisional_assumptions: Endoxifen and tamoxifen SMILES are provisional CID-traceable inputs.
Naltrexone uses an explicit RCSB chemical-component SMILES because the installed CCD cache lacks YOE.
One protein entity with count two represents the same-sequence TtgR homodimer in every state.
